scientific_question: Within the fixed Kudla exact-CDS cohort and frozen sequence-cluster OOD, does the retrospective local-structure increment specifically require native upstream 4 nt and/or native start ATG when length, CDS4-38 body, model, folds and inference are matched?

cohort.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of log10_expression within exact CDS; identical CDS, UTR, full mRNA, protein and CAI required within a group.
cohort.cluster_definition: Reuse RK27/RK32 frozen 90% complete-linkage clusters and fold assignments without reclustering or outcome-dependent filtering.

factorial_contexts.vienna: RNA.md(); temperature=37 C; isolated 42 nt; dangles=2 confirmatory and dangles=0 sensitivity

models.histgb: HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=squared_error, learning_rate=0.05, max_iter=200, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=10, l2_regularization=1.0, early_stopping=False, random_state=seed+fold)

outer_evaluation.fold_assignment: Exactly reproduce RK27/RK32 make_cluster_folds and accepted fold CSV; no sequence cluster in both train and test.
outer_evaluation.leakage_rule: No target or model result may be used for clustering, fold assignment, arm selection or tuning.

fit_accounting.formula: 10 seeds * 5 folds * 2 models * 7 non-reused arms = 700 new; accepted RK32 simple + exact_d2 contribute 200 reused; 900 evaluated.

comparisons.direction: For A versus B: Spearman rho(A)-rho(B), MSE(B)-MSE(A); positive favors A.
comparisons.primary: All five families at dangles=2; exact_real_d2 reuses accepted RK32 Vienna-local OOF.
comparisons.sensitivity: The same five families at dangles=0; sensitivity cannot upgrade a failed primary result.

primary_inference.bootstrap: Resample 37 cluster IDs with replacement, include all exact-CDS rows from each selected cluster, recompute paired OOF effects and take percentile 95% CI.
primary_inference.permutation: Draw one sign per cluster and swap A/B OOF predictions within clusters; two-sided absolute-effect p-values with plus-one correction.
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm separately across 20 confirmatory dangles=2 tests and 20 sensitivity dangles=0 tests.
primary_inference.seed_stability: At least 8 of 10 seed-level effects must be positive.
primary_inference.endpoint_pass_rule: Observed effect >0, bootstrap CI lower bound >0, Holm p<0.05 and at least 8/10 positive seeds.
primary_inference.family_pass_rule: All four endpoints (2 models * 2 metrics) pass.
primary_inference.upstream_contribution_rule: Both upstream_given_start and upstream_without_start families pass.
primary_inference.start_contribution_rule: Both start_given_upstream and start_without_upstream families pass.
